directions.title: Brain development and neuroimaging genetics
directions.desc: Uncovering the associations among brain evolution, development, and psychiatric disorders using multiple MRI and spatial transcriptomic data
directions.desc_zh: 结合多模态磁共振成像与空间转录组数据，揭示脑进化、脑发育与精神疾病之间的关联

directions.title: Brain connectomics and dynamics
directions.desc: Characterizing aberrant brain network organization using connectomics, gradients, effective connectivity and temporal dynamics
directions.desc_zh: 利用连接组学、功能梯度、有效连接与时间动态，刻画精神疾病中的异常脑网络组织

directions.title: Environmental factors and proteomics
directions.title_zh: 环境因素与蛋白质组学
directions.desc: Modeling pathophysiological mechanisms by integrating neuroimaging, environmental exposure, and proteomic data
directions.desc_zh: 融合脑影像、环境暴露与蛋白质组数据，建模精神疾病的病理生理机制

directions.title: Pattern recognition and intervention
directions.desc: Developing machine-learning methods to predict symptoms, treatment response and illness trajectories, and further aiding clinical interventions
directions.desc_zh: 发展机器学习方法，预测症状、治疗反应与疾病转归，辅助临床干预
